models.description:
System-wide application configuration settings.

Stores key-value pairs for application-wide settings that control system behavior, features, and operational parameters. These configurations affect all users and are typically managed by system administrators rather than individual users.

Configurations include settings like maximum task limits, session timeouts, feature flags, and other system-level parameters that maintain consistent application behavior across all user interactions. Each configuration entry maintains a unique key with flexible value storage for different data types.
models.name: todo_app_configurations

plainFields.description: Unique configuration key identifier used for lookups and type safety validation
plainFields.name: key

plainFields.description: Configuration value stored as string with flexible parsing for different data types
plainFields.name: value

plainFields.description: Human-readable description explaining the configuration's purpose and usage
plainFields.name: description

plainFields.description: Configuration category grouping for organization and administrative management
plainFields.name: category

plainFields.description: Whether this configuration is currently active and enforced by the system
plainFields.name: is_enabled

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was initially created
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was last modified
plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for configuration history
plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.description:
User accounts for authentication and task ownership.

Each user has their own private todo list and can only access tasks they created. The user entity serves as the primary actor for task management operations across the application.
models.name: todo_app_users

plainFields.description: User email address used for authentication. Must be unique across all users and follows RFC 5322 format.
plainFields.name: email

plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication. Meets security requirements of minimum 8 characters with letters and numbers.
plainFields.name: password_hash

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last modified.
plainFields.name: updated_at

models.description:
User session management for authentication tracking.

Sessions enable secure user authentication across multiple devices while maintaining audit trails of login activity.

foreignFields.description: Reference to the user account this session belongs to. {@link todo_app_users.id}
foreignFields.name: user_id

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions

plainFields.description: IP address of the user's connection for security tracking.
plainFields.name: ip

plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was established.
plainFields.name: href

plainFields.description: Referrer URL that directed to the session creation.
plainFields.name: referrer

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Null if the session is currently active.
plainFields.name: expired_at

models.name: todo_app_tasks
models.description:
Core todo task entity representing individual items in a user's personal task list.

Tasks are the fundamental business entity of the todo application, enabling users to capture, track, and complete their daily responsibilities. Each task belongs exclusively to one user and maintains privacy through strict ownership rules.

Tasks support a simple lifecycle: creation, modification, completion, and deletion. The completion status provides immediate visual feedback about progress, while creation timestamps enable chronological organization.

Soft deletion allows users to remove tasks while preserving audit trails for data integrity. The task title captures the essential description of the responsibility, supporting up to 200 characters for detailed task descriptions.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Task owner's {@link todo_app_users.id}. Each task belongs to exactly one authenticated user.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title describing the responsibility or action needed. Limited to 200 characters for concise descriptions.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description providing additional context or notes about the task. Supports longer form content.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current task completion status. Values: 'pending' for incomplete tasks, 'complete' for finished tasks.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was marked as complete. Null for pending tasks.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Task creation timestamp. Records when the user first created this task.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp. Updates whenever task properties change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Records when task was deleted while preserving historical data.

models.name: todo_app_task_snapshots
models.description:
Historical snapshots of todo tasks capturing point-in-time states for audit trails and change tracking.

Task snapshots preserve the complete state of tasks at specific moments, enabling users to track modification history and maintain audit trails for personal organization accountability. Each snapshot captures an immutable record of task properties including title, description, status, and completion details.

The snapshot pattern is essential for maintaining data integrity when users modify existing tasks, providing historical context that might be needed for personal productivity analysis, accountability tracking, or recovering from accidental changes.

Snapshots are created automatically when tasks are modified, forming an append-only historical record that supports long-term productivity insights and ensures users can understand how their task organization evolved over time.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_task_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the original task's {@link todo_app_tasks.id}. Links snapshot to source task.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Snapshot owner's {@link todo_app_users.id}. Maintains ownership tracking for historical records.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title at the time of snapshot. Preserves exact wording during this historical moment.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Task description at the time of snapshot. Maintains additional context if present.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Task status at snapshot time. Records completion state during this historical moment.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Completion timestamp at snapshot time. Records when task was completed if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp. Records when this historical snapshot was captured.
